'''Skela''' served as a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Hapan Royal Navy]] sometime in [[44 ABY]]. Skela participated in the [[Evacuation of Ossus (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|evacuation]] of the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]. During the evacuation, a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[GAT-12 Skipray Blastboat|Skipray twelve-jays]] piloted by [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith]] appeared and Skela recommended to [[Queen Mother]] [[Tenel Ka Djo]] to send two [[Fighter wing/Legends|wings]] of [[Miy'til starfighter]]s to reinforce [[Vhork Squadron]]. Choosing to err on the side of caution, Tenel Ka chose to send four wings instead.<ref name="apocalypse" />
